The '''Asamin system''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]]. A notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]] production point, it was where the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zayl Braith]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to a wealthy family of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]]. Braith eventually became a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] operating in the star system and elsewhere, and, when she later worked as part of a [[Tiron Til's criminal syndicate|criminal syndicate]], she ultimately left the organization after it began working against the interests of her former partners in the Asamin system. A [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, the system was part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
The Asamin system was a part of the [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Essien Run]]<ref name="AIR" /> and was linked via [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes to the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector's]] [[Tartaglia system/Legends|Tartaglia system]], a [[Triewahl system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Homon sector/Legends|Homon sector]], and another [[Star system/Legends|system]] in<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Mezeg sector/Legends|Mezeg sector]].<ref name="MidRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> The Asamin system was a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]] production site.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Zayl_Braith.png|thumb|right|250px|The smuggler Zayl Braith was born in the Asamin system.]]
The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zayl Braith]] hailed from the Asamin system, where she was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to an affluent family of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] who operated along the Essien Run, primarily in the Asamin system. At a relatively early age, Braith began associating with [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and she eventually worked for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thi Sawrtin]] on numerous smuggling runs in the Asamin system.<ref name="AIR" />

On one run in the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]]<ref name="AIR" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EGTW" /> however, Sawrtin and Braith were captured by authorities of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] the captain and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] Braith. The latter ultimately escaped [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] and subsequently began smuggling for a [[Tiron Til's criminal syndicate|criminal syndicate]] led by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Tiron Til]].<ref name="AIR" /> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] smugglers attempted to establish a monopoly in the Asamin system's spice trade, and, after Til made several deals with the group, Braith, out of loyalty she felt to her former partners, left Til's syndicate.<ref name="AIR" /> The Asamin system was part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Asamin system was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed it in grid square M-7.<ref name="TEA" />
